summary: Business history reader options: history.Field.ValueKeyPrefix/ValueLabel translate stored codes (Item.Display carries localized labels and value texts with the code kept); history.Resource.Labels captions objects with one batched call per page, with captions recorded on events (Subject.Label, Mutation.Label) so deleted objects keep theirs; history.Resource.Visible (VisibleAll/VisibleIDs/VisibleWhere) hides events of objects outside the reader's set in SQL before pagination; history.WithResource helper; Service.Subject. Finance translates counterparty, transaction and debt codes and captions counterparties and money accounts. historypage.Group no longer takes a field-label function.
